page.overview:
Who is Amber?

Amber is a student of Springfield Elementary in the future. She makes her first and only appearance in "Estranger Things."

Amber gives a speech on the stage to the kids introducing Lisa Simpson. She hands the microphone to Lisa, whom Amber describes as the greatest person and her hero.
